comment: O11 of batch 2026-11-04-open-thermo-data (owner decision E25): a crude_pr78 CO2 dataset in the Tier 1 form, its freezing data from the CO2-I crystal anchor. The partners are the eight pure compounds whose CO2 pairs no library gives yet; the 24 Tier 1 compounds' CO2 pairs are already in icheme:dwsim_refinery_pr78 (reproduced by the O11 check run). The pairs and the Tr = 0.7 point go to records of their own, so no view without CO2 changes its identity. Run with --materials <src/main/resources/data/icheme/materials>.

compounds.freezing_note: CO2 sublimes at 1 atm (194.7 K) and has no normal melting point: normal_melting_kelvin holds the triple point. The fusion enthalpy is the crystal's effective value, chosen for the pilot family (ChemSep's own heat of fusion is the same 9019 J/mol; its triple point 216.58 K, 518672 Pa).
